turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey! How's everything going?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Kind of tired, honestly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Two different friends invited me to things on Saturday night.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Popular weekend. Is it a choice between a big party and something smaller, or are they both similar?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One's a birthday party, the other is a quiet dinner.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Got it. Which one would you be more disappointed to miss?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, what were you saying?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just that the bus was late again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Jordan, can you drive us to the airport on Friday morning?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: What time is the flight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Seven forty, so we'd need to leave around five.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Five in the morning? You owe me big for that one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll bring you back something nice, I promise. What do you want?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Chocolate. Lots of chocolate.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that took a while. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Any closer to deciding between the two invitations?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The dinner. I barely get to see that friend.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then go to the dinner and send a nice message to the birthday person.
